Privacy

Your information and our website.

This page explains the practical information handling used by Increase Original Super Store when you browse the website or contact a branch.

Information you choose to share

If you call or message us, you may choose to share your name, phone number, delivery location, preferred device, budget or order details. We use that information to respond to your enquiry, confirm stock and coordinate pickup or delivery.

Website data

The website may receive basic technical information needed to load pages, protect the service and understand aggregate usage. If Google Analytics or another measurement tool is added later, the site owner should update this policy and configure it according to the applicable requirements.

Third-party links

WhatsApp, Google Maps, Google Analytics, Google Search and other linked services have their own privacy policies. Review those policies when you use those services.

Questions

For privacy questions, contact the business through the listed branch phone or WhatsApp numbers.
